title: Aaron Glenn: Congrats to Russell Wilson on TV job, we're looking at QB options

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Aaron Glenn: Congrats to Russell Wilson on TV job, we're looking at QB options
sources.description: Russell Wilson is joining CBS as an analyst on The NFL Today for the 2026 season and he chose that job over an opportunity to serve as the backup quarterback to Geno Smith with the Jets.
